claims: League of Legends is a free-to-play 5v5 team-based MOBA.
League of Legends was developed by Riot Games.
League of Legends is for Windows and macOS.
League of Legends focuses on destroying the enemy team's base (Nexus).
League of Legends has over 170 unique champions.
League of Legends champions range from tanks and mages to assassins.
League of Legends matches are 30-minute matches.
Top Lane, Jungle, Mid Lane, Attack Damage Carry (ADC), and Support.
League of Legends is available on PC (Windows) and Mac (macOS).
League of Legends generally requires a modern processor (Intel Core i3-530 or AMD A6-3650).
League of Legends requires at least 2GB of RAM.
League of Legends recommends 4GB or more RAM.
League of Legends requires a graphics card (NVIDIA GeForce 9600GT or AMD HD 6570).
League of Legends requires roughly 16GB of free disk space.
League of Legends uses a standard keyboard and mouse layout.
League of Legends default display settings are changeable via the video menu or Alt + Enter.
Summoner's Rift is the main 5v5 competitive map.
Howling Abyss (ARAM) is a single-lane battle mode.
Teamfight Tactics (TFT) is an auto-battler game mode located within the same client.
